acf.answer: The design supports lot-specific purity and COA fields for every catalog item. Final testing claims should be populated only from documentation supplied and approved by the client.

title.rendered: What is a Certificate of Analysis (COA)?

acf.answer: A COA is a lot-specific document that can be linked directly from a product record. The WordPress-ready data model includes a dedicated COA URL for each product.

title.rendered: Are these products for human use?

acf.answer: No. This concept consistently labels the catalog as Research Use Only and not for human or veterinary consumption.
Items are stored in the browser as a checkout list. The checkout form collects contact, shipping, and order-note information. Payment is not collected by this preview.
